name: Kenji Saitō
equipment: Mon banner of the Saitō clan
A folded set of campaign letters from a fallen lord
Whetstone and oiled cloth for sword care
features: Fighting Style: Defense (+1 AC while wearing armor)
Second Wind (bonus action to regain 1d10+1 HP, once per short/long rest)
Military Rank (Soldier feature: soldiers of lower rank defer to your authority)
Bushidō Code (personal code of honor, loyalty, and courage)

personality.traits: I carry myself with rigid composure and speak only when my words will serve a purpose. ⚔️ I bow to those who have earned my respect and never to those who have not. A drawn blade is a promise I intend to keep.
personality.ideals: Honor. Bushidō is the spine of a worthy life — loyalty, courage, and rectitude. A samurai without honor is already a corpse that has forgotten to fall.
personality.bonds: My lord, Lord Saitō, died in the burning of Tsuruga castle, and his banner is all that remains of the house I swore to defend. I am rōnin now — a masterless wave on the sea — and I wander seeking a cause worthy of my steel.
personality.flaws: My pride in my honor can blind me to mercy and patience. I would rather die a clean death than live with a single stain on my name, and I sometimes mistake stubbornness for principle.

appearance: A lean, disciplined man of Hinomoto in his early thirties, standing tall with the upright bearing of a trained warrior. ⛩️ His black hair is gathered into a tight topknot, and a pale scar crosses his left brow — a souvenir of the siege that broke his clan. He wears lacquered lamellar armor of deep indigo plates laced with faded crimson cord, the Saitō mon stitched at the shoulder. At his left hip rest the paired blades, katana and wakizashi, their saya worn smooth from constant care. His gaze is steady, his movements economical, and there is a stillness to him like a sword held a breath before the cut.
backstory: Kenji Saitō was born to a minor retainer family sworn to the lords of Tsuruga, on the misty northern coast of Hinomoto. From the age of six he trained in the way of the sword, in calligraphy, and in the unyielding precepts of bushidō. He served Lord Saitō faithfully through a decade of border skirmishes and rose to command a spear of footmen. When a rival warlord's army descended on Tsuruga castle under a moonless sky, Kenji fought through the burning keep to reach his lord — and arrived only in time to watch the man he had sworn his life to die beneath a collapsing gate. Bound by honor to neither flee nor follow his master into death without purpose, Kenji took up his lord's mon banner and walked out of the ashes a rōnin. Now he travels the floating world of warring provinces, restless spirits, and grasping nobles, searching for a cause that might give his blade meaning again — and perhaps, in time, redeem the failure that still smolders behind his calm.
